description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 2.  A red line, marked with star-shaped markers, begins at approximately (0, 24.5) and increases to approximately (8, 29.5), showing a steady increase with no apparent peaks or declines. A purple line, marked with circular markers, begins at approximately (0, 21) and increases to approximately (8, 29), also showing a steady increase. A blue line, marked with square markers, begins at approximately (0, 22) and increases to approximately (8, 28.5), exhibiting a similar steady increase.
